web.title: Brainly for Parents: AI Homework Help & Test Prep, Grades 7–12
web.description:
# Top students aren't smarter.  They're better equipped.
## What the first few weekslook like.
They log in and Brainly starts learning how they work.

## The questions parentsask first.
Brainly reads each moment and picks one of three responses: a full explanation when your teen is genuinely missing something, a nudge when they’re close and just aren’t connecting it, and a question back when the signals say they’re trying to hand the work over.

A general chatbot answers the question your teen typed and forgets it happened. Brainly works backwards from the question to what’s actually missing underneath it; two students can ask the same thing word for word and need completely different help.

Brainly is built for students. It explains without doing the work for them. Brainly is also a member of the EdSafe AI Alliance.
